B-1: Empty search shows a spinner forever done

Clearing the box on the recipe search page leaves the loading spinner running, and the empty state never appears.

Severity
Medium. The page is stuck until the user types again. No data is lost.
Environment
Larder web app, local dev server and staging; Chrome 129 and Firefox 131; desktop and phone viewports.
Version / commit
v0.8.3 at 4c1e9a2
First seen
2026-10-14, in the recipe search sweep
Reproducibility
always (5 of 5)
Last known good
v0.8.2 at 9b07d31
Regression window
9b07d31..4c1e9a2, one commit: "Show spinner immediately on keystroke"

Related: sweep · decisions · cover sheet · verification · post-mortem · trace

Repro

  1. Start from a clean state: pnpm dev with the seeded recipe fixture, a fresh browser profile, signed out.
  2. Open /search.
  3. Type soup and wait for results (12 recipes).
  4. Select the text in the search box and delete it.
  5. Wait 5 seconds.

Submitting an empty box with Enter, without typing first, also reproduces it.

Expected

Within a moment of clearing the box, the spinner goes away and the page shows the "Type to search recipes" empty state, as it did in v0.8.2.

[ASSUMPTION: an empty query should show the "Type to search recipes" empty state, as v0.8.2 did, not the last results.]

Actual

The spinner keeps turning. The old results are hidden and the empty state never shows. Typing any letter brings the page back.

Evidence

Known (observed), not guessed:

  • Screenshot after 5 seconds: B-1-spinner-desktop-light.svg.
  • Network panel: no request to /api/recipes after the box is cleared. The last request (q=soup) returned 200 in 140 ms.
  • Component state in the React devtools after clearing: { query: "", loading: true, results: [], error: null }.
  • A failing unit test, written by the investigator, reproduces it without a browser:
FAIL  src/search/useSearch.test.ts
  useSearch
    x clears loading when the query is emptied (1012 ms)
      expect(result.current.loading).toBe(false)
      Expected: false
      Received: true

No console errors appear.

Likely locus

WhereWhyConfidence
src/search/useSearch.ts, the effect at lines 18 to 31setLoading(true) now runs before the if (!query.trim()) return guard.high
src/search/SearchPage.tsx, the spinner conditionShows the spinner whenever loading is true, before checking the query.medium
src/api/recipes.tsThe abort path on a cancelled request swallows the error.low

Hypotheses

Ranked by how well they fit the evidence. None is chosen here.

  1. The empty guard returns after loading is set. Fits all the evidence: no request, loading: true, and the window is one commit that moved that line.
  2. Clearing aborts the in-flight request, and the abort path never resets loading. Would also leave loading on, but the last request had already finished before the box was cleared.
  3. The spinner reads stale state. Would show a spinner with loading: false; the devtools show true, so this fits worst.

Gone when

Given the search page is showing results for "soup"
When the user clears the search box
Then within 300 ms the spinner is gone and the "Type to search recipes" empty state shows

Continues to show the spinner while a non-empty query is loading, then its results
Continues to show the error banner when the request fails
Continues to keep the ?q= URL parameter in step with the box

Route

direct-to-implementer The locus is one hook, the fix is small, and nothing needs choosing. Approved as D-1.

Files allowed
src/search/useSearch.ts, src/search/useSearch.test.ts, and src/search/SearchPage.tsx (the empty-state branch only)
Constraints
No new dependencies. Keep the 250 ms debounce. Keep the spinner and empty-state designs as they are.
Ask first
Changing src/api/recipes.ts, the debounce, or any page other than search.
Escalate if
The new test still fails with the guard moved, or the fix grows past about 40 changed lines.

Not doing here

  • The fix itself; the implementer writes it against the files above.
  • Refactoring the search hook into a reducer.
  • A plan for the two suspected items in the sweep; they stay there until a later sweep confirms them.
